0.content: Xiangling of Wanmin Restaurant is one of the few people Xinyan can talk to freely. Xinyan visits for late-night meals and chats into the night. She deliberately eats every experimental dish that others flee from, because the "taste bud explosion" sparks musical ideas, and she calls Xiangling the rock star of the culinary world. Xiangling says Xinyan enjoys nine out of ten of them. Xiangling is less sure "that dish rocked!" is a compliment.

1.content: Yun Jin, the star of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe, is secretly devoted to rock. She attends Xinyan's shows at least three times a week, however busy she is, and Xinyan asks people to keep it secret. The troupe's elders disapprove of rock, so Yun Jin tells them she is visiting "Xingyan", the accomplished adopted daughter of a Fan Er'ye, to discuss opera. When Yun Jin first visited Xinyan's spotless home, Xinyan feared the contrast would put her off. It only made Yun Jin a bigger fan.

2.content: Xinyan and Beidou are both blunt and big-hearted and get on great. The Crux's adventures inspired a song that sailors now join in on after its first line, and Xinyan says it is fast becoming a sea shanty. Beidou says her crew loves Xinyan's rock 'n' roll; the two have much in common, but not musical taste.

3.comment: Xinyan: The Millelith and the friends of rock
3.content: Xinyan's makeshift stages tend to burn down halfway through a show. After many warnings the Millelith stepped up patrols to stop her. She usually won the battle of wits, finding a spot and building a stage at frightening speed. Many guards became fans, "friends of rock", and leaked their patrol plans to her; one, Kun, openly urges visitors to see her shows. Since nobody was ever harmed, the Millelith adopted a "one eye open, one eye shut" approach.

4.content: Her hand-made instrument started as a copy of a Fontaine rock instrument and quickly stopped looking like one. It resembles a square ruan. A crescent axe-blade on the tail makes it a weapon in a pinch. It is wired to her Vision to spew flames and sparks, and it can burn itself up rather than fall into the wrong hands. She calls it a guitar or a lyre; Beidou calls it her "axe". She wants a cool name and has tried "The Fyre Lyre", "The Jadebreaker" and "The Hill Stiller", but none feel right yet.

5.comment: Xinyan: Zhongli, Hu Tao and the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
5.content: When almost no one would hear her music, Zhongli invited Xinyan to perform at "his place". She accepted happily and only on arrival learned it was the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, where he is consultant. She still calls him a weird guy. Hu Tao, the parlour's director, always greets her cheerily, saying she likes people who play with fire because they are "good for business". Xinyan finds her bizarre.

6.content: Chongyun avoids her shows because the heat gets to him, but he once climbed onstage and sang his heart out after a friend brought him to a show. Xingqiu sighs that no spot from Chihu Rock to Yujing Terrace escapes her "disruptive presence". Keqing says her music is noisy by traditional standards but rocks, and good music should reach everyone. Baizhu's prescriptions protect her voice; his snake Changsheng fainted at her thank-you performance and now hides up his sleeve. Gaming says Man Chai goes wild for her music and wants a "Roaring Beasts" rock-and-wushou show with her. Yanfei, after seeing a show, decided that if she ever needs a new career she will be a rapper.
